{{Quote|Good morning. I trust that you are all well? My name, for those who don't recognize me, is Dee'Hars. I am a bounty hunter in the employ of Riboga the Hutt.|Dee'Hars, to the Heroes of Cularin|<ref name="Strike III">{{LivingForce|For Every Action: Strike III}}</ref>}}
'''Dee'Hars''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] who made a living as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], working in conjunction with fellow [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunters [[Clargod]], [[Kelyan]] and [[Kiimo]]. In about [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the Dee'Hars and his team traveled to the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Gadrin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], where they hoped to capture [[Mattenic]] and [[Kerkum]], two former [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenants]] of the deposed [[Oblee]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Nirama]] who had had a bounty placed on their heads by the [[Office of Peace and Security]], a local [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agency]]. However, the [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance agents that operated in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], were also looking for Mattenic and Kerkum, and the agents prevented Dee'Hars and the other bounty hunters from capturing the pair.<ref name="Preemptive Strike" />

A short time afterward, the Heroes of Cularin destroyed a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operation that was ran by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Riboga]] on the planet [[Kemix]],<ref name="Counterstrike">{{LivingForce|For Every Action: Counterstrike}}</ref> and the Hutt hired Dee'Hars, Clargod, Kelyan and Kiimo to bring the agents into a state of despair, then [[Death/Legends|kill]] them. The bounty hunters placed explosives aboard a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that the agents were traveling on and then detonated the devices, which brought the agent's vessel out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and caused it to crash on the planet [[Holador]]. The bounty hunters then landed on the world and set up a number of traps, to sap the morale of the agents in preparation for Riboga's planned execution of the agents. However, Dee'Hars suspected that the agents would survive all of the traps set up by his fellow bounty hunters, so he set up an elaborate final trap for them, in which he planned to use [[Deflector shield/Legends|energy shields]] to restrict their movements. However, despite Dee'Hars' efforts, the agents defeated and captured him.<ref name="Strike III" />
